$comment: The compliance fence (CTO ruling CR-27, CCO-aligned). Two tiers. `protected`: only the assigned agents may change these, and the PR needs the `agent:<handle>` label of one of them plus a CCO approval and a Karma approval on its current head commit. `cco_review`: any agent may change these (for example `mobile` owns the age gate), but the PR needs a CCO approval on its head. A path is also caught when its diff mentions a marker in `content_markers` (so a migration cannot dodge the fence by its file name; matched without regard to case); a matching file whose diff GitHub does not return is treated as caught. The check reads this file from the base branch, never from the pull request, and changing it is itself fenced. Approval lines, each alone on a line (up to three leading spaces, as a Markdown heading allows; CR-38), from the repository owner's login only: `## CCO approval at <40-hex head sha>: APPROVED (CCO-<n>)` (a ruling in docs/agents/exec/RULINGS.md), `## Karma approval at <40-hex head sha>: APPROVED (CR-<n>)`. Procedure: compliance/README.md.
